title: Tension in rope
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly calculates the tension T = 10 N from the equilibrium of block A on the incline.

title: Height B rises
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly calculates the total height h = 0.24 m that block B rises.

title: Force equilibrium for B
description: Important Criteria: Applies vector addition to find the total upward force on B from the rope tensions (2T cos(α/2)).

title: Spring compressions/extensions
description: Important Criteria: Correctly applies Hooke's Law to find the initial compression of spring 2 (Δx₁) and the extensions of springs 1 and 2 (Δx₂, Δx₃) in the final state.

title: Displacement addition
description: Important Criteria: Recognizes that the total rise of B is the sum of the changes in length of all connected springs (Δx₁ + Δx₂ + Δx₃).

title: Incorrect friction direction
description: Pitfall Criteria: Uses the wrong sign for the friction force when setting up the equilibrium equation for block A.

title: Rope force composition error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Incorrectly calculates the total upward force on block B (e.g., using T instead of 2T cos(α/2)).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Maintains consistent units (N, m, kg) throughout the calculation.
